topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Course Overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the scope of the cancer biology lecture series, its multidisciplinary audience, and the key learning outcomes for the session.

topics.label: Cancer as a Failure of Cellular Differentiation and Tissue Organization
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics establish the biological foundation of cancer as a multistep breakdown of normal developmental differentiation and three-dimensional tissue architecture, noting the challenges of modeling this in vitro.

topics.label: Invasion, Progression, and Nomenclature of Benign and Malignant Neoplasms
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how benign and malignant tumors are distinguished by basement membrane invasion and metastasis, illustrated through colorectal tumor progression and standard pathological nomenclature.

topics.label: Pathophysiological Mechanisms of Cancer Morbidity and Mortality
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the mechanical, systemic, and metabolic disruptions through which primary tumors and secondary metastases cause physical decline and patient death.

topics.label: Comparative Oncology and Cancer Incidence Across Tissues and Species
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics compare cancer incidence patterns across human tissue types and diverse animal taxa to demonstrate that neoplasia is a fundamental vulnerability of multicellular life.

topics.label: Clinical Presentation and Diagnostic Screening Strategies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate the principles, clinical efficacy, and practical challenges of population-level screening programs for early cancer detection.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Practical Briefing
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture by reviewing the learning outcomes and providing housekeeping notes for upcoming practicals and lectures.
